hItems.title: Adelaide Crows
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the Adelaide Crows, or currently on their list.

hItems.title: 150+ GAMES
hItems.subtitle: SAME CLUB
hItems.description: Played 150 or more games at VFL/AFL level for a single club. Can also have played games for other clubs (including finals).

vItems.title: 20+ DISPOSALS
vItems.subtitle: AVG (SEASON)
vItems.description: Averaged 20 or more disposals per game for a single season (since 1965).

vItems.title: RORY LAIRD
vItems.subtitle: RORY LAIRD TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Rory Laird.

vItems.title: RISING STAR
vItems.subtitle: NOMINATION
vItems.description: Received a nomination for the Rising Star award (1993 onwards).
